messages:
raj: onboarding quickstart: SSE stream goes silent after ~30s, client remains OPEN and never reconnects. repro on mac + CI runner.
ellie: which sdk/sampleapp?
raj: node quickstart using eventsource-polyfill. no console errors, just silence. :confused:
samir: my guess is keepalive vs auth refresh at the proxy layer. any 401s or socket closes?
raj: none. local runner logs around the stall:
raj: [2026-03-17T21:03:12Z] stream: send keepalive
raj: [2026-03-17T21:03:42Z] auth: refresh start
raj: [2026-03-17T21:03:42Z] proxy: upgrade OK
raj: [2026-03-17T21:03:42Z] stream: received blank chunk (just CRLF)
raj: [2026-03-17T21:03:42Z] auth: refresh done
raj: [2026-03-17T21:03:45Z] stream: no data for 10s, client still reports OPEN
ellie: blank chunk as keepalive. but if the proxy pauses & later splices a blank chunk with the following data event it can clobber last-event-id and confuse our SSE reassembly. result: socket stays open, app sees no events.
raj: simple mitigation?
samir: client watchdog: track last message timestamp and if older than threshold (e.g. 2x keepalive) do es.close() and recreate EventSource. tiny change to sampleapp.
ellie: also add README note: "If you hit silent stalls during onboarding, enable WATCHDOG env or increase keepalive." I'll draft it.
raj: current sample snippet:
raj: const es = new EventSource(url); es.onmessage = (e) => console.log('msg', e.data); es.onopen = () => console.log('open'); es.onerror = () => console.log('err');
samir: patch: maintain lastSeen = Date.now() on message; setInterval(() => { if (Date.now() - lastSeen > THRESH) { es.close(); es = new EventSource(url); } }, CHECK_INTERVAL);
ellie: server-side signal is helpful (emit SSE comment ":auth-refresh start/end") but can be lost in proxies. prefer client watchdog + optional server comment.
devex-bot: @samir opened PR draft https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapps/pull/512 adding watchdog + README note. :rocket:
ellie: add a tiny CI repro (netcat splicing a blank chunk during auth refresh) that asserts client reconnects. add docs about client libs that collapse blank lines vs keepalive.
raj: adding repro script+logs to PR. merging README+watchdog once CI passes. closing onboarding ticket after staging deploy. :white_check_mark:
samir: will add flaky-tolerant netcat test and mention in devex docs.
raj: thanks all — saved my onboarding call earlier.
